entities.name: Charles Honoré d'Albert, duc de Luynes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Honoré d'Albert de Luynes was a French nobleman and Duke of Luynes. He is best known as the Duke of Chevreuse, his family's subsidiary title which he used until his father's death in 1690. He was a high-ranking French official under King Louis XIV.
